name: Quarryman's Pick (Thạch Công Phủ)

arts.name: Pick Fall (Thạch Phủ Trụy)
arts.rule: One heavy overhead stroke: an Earth hit that lays 2 Earth stacks for 6 s. It is a heavy art, so Aftershock Slam counts it.

lore: A short-hafted iron pick that quarry gangs hand to apprentices once they can lift it for a day.
build_use: The Mountain Seal and Deep Vein builds' first weapon: a cheap heavy Earth hit that lays the Earth stacks their arts spend.

name: Clay Seal Ring (Nê Ấn Giới)
lore: Fired river clay stamped with a sect seal; it never chips.
build_use: The Mountain That Pays: a stronger Earth buff against Physical hits and a little health, from the first season.

name: Robe of Settling Dust (Trần Lạc Đạo Bào)

wards.name: Settling Dust Shirt (Trần Lạc Sam)
wards.notes: The starter shirt at 0.8 of its payload and its reservation, so the price check is unchanged (3.019 of 3.050)

lore: Sand-coloured silk that sheds a haze of dust at every step, so foes strike where its wearer was.
build_use: The Dust Veil: evade and longer Earth debuff stacks make the foe's misses pile up, and Beneath Notice lets it slip away from higher realms.

name: Pendant of the Remembering Stone (Thạch Ký Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Still Stone Aura (Tĩnh Thạch Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your Earth buff stacks are 15 % stronger and you resist 100 points more Physical damage.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (3.75 + 3.2 = 6.95)

lore: A river pebble worn smooth by a thousand years of current, hung on a plain cord.
build_use: The Mountain That Pays: a standing Earth-buff and Physical-resistance upgrade paid in linh lực, with regeneration so the ward keeps paying.

name: Boundary Flag of the Field Lord (Điền Chủ Giới Kỳ)

effects.name: Planted Banner (Thụ Kỳ)
effects.rule: Your Earth parts deal 2 % more for every 4 Earth buff stacks you hold.
effects.from: single-earth.md, The Mountain That Pays and The Field Lord (Earth buff stacks as the build's currency)

lore: The cloth of a field boundary banner; where it is driven in, the ground is its owner's.
build_use: The Field Lord and The Mountain That Pays: every Earth buff stack also raises Earth damage, so a fortress of stacks hits back harder.

name: Mountain-Mooring Anchor (Hệ Sơn Mao)

arts.name: Mooring Drop (Mao Trầm Địa)
arts.rule: Counts as a Mountain Heart Canon art. The anchor drops as a Physical hit and lays 2 Strata. With 5 Strata, and the foe Slowed 2 deep, Mountain Stance, or two canon arts fired in the last 4 s, it moors the foe: spends 5 Strata for a hit 2.8 times as hard, 2 Slowed Time and a 1.5 s delay on every foe art.

lore: A ship's anchor from the old river-sect forges, re-cast to hold a mountain's weight rather than a boat's.
build_use: The Mountain Seal and Mountain Heart Canon builds: a fifth canon art that feeds Strata to the Hammer and locks the foe in place.

name: Boulder-Ring Mail (Cự Thạch Hoàn Giáp)

wards.name: Boulder Shell (Cự Thạch Xác)
wards.notes: The starter shell at 1.5 times its payload and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (4.711 of 4.766)

lore: Overlapping plates cut from a single boulder and joined with iron rings.
build_use: The Mountain That Pays: every Physical art refills the body shield and the shell covers Physical hits, so Bastion Reprisal's wall keeps standing.

name: Necklace of Stone Debt (Thạch Trái Liên)

effects.name: Debt of Stone (Thạch Trái)
effects.rule: When an art of yours is paid in health, you gain 1 Earth buff stack for 15 s for each 2 % of maximum health paid.
effects.reads: Health paid by your arts, live
effects.from: single-earth.md and family-earth.md (Quarry Offering's health payment)

lore: Beads of quarry stone, each said to be owed to the mountain it was cut from.
build_use: The Deep Vein health-payer: Quarry Offering's 7 % health cost returns 3 Earth stacks, and the leech and regeneration pay the debt back.

name: Mountain-Pressing Seal (Áp Sơn Ấn)

arts.name: Mountain Presses the Sky (Sơn Áp Thiên)
arts.rule: Counts as a Deep Vein Scripture art. A slow heavy Earth seal that lays 4 Earth stacks for 6 s. With 10 Earth stacks on the foe, and either three deep-vein arts fired in 8 s or the foe Slowed 3 deep, it presses the mountain down: spends 10 stacks for a hit 4.2 times as hard that Sunders and adds 2 Slowed Time.

holder: An elder of an Earth sect at Nascent Soul; otherwise Lost beneath a collapsed mountain pass
lore: The seal that held a sect's founding peak in place, carved from the peak's own heart.
build_use: The Mountain Seal's keystone piece: a heavy seal that counts for the Deep Vein suite and turns a pile of Earth stacks into a Sundering press.

name: Unmoving Gate Shield (Bất Động Môn Thuẫn)

effects.name: Unmoved Stance (Bất Động Thế)
effects.rule: The art-speed and basic-speed penalties of your stances do not apply to you.
effects.closes: Your evade is 0 while a stance is on.
effects.from: single-earth.md, The Mountain That Pays (Mountain Stance without its slowness)

wards.name: Gate Screen (Môn Bình Chướng)
wards.notes: The starter screen at 1.6 times its shield and its reservation, so the price check is unchanged (3.000 of 3.050)

holder: The gate guardian of an Earth sect, a Core Formation elder; otherwise Lost in a flooded quarry
lore: The door of a sect's vault, beaten into a shield; nothing has ever pushed it back.
build_use: The Mountain That Pays: Mountain Stance without its slowness, a standing screen, and every shield that breaks bursts on the foe.
